what_this_is: The Workshop rows for the video editing tools in tools/media-composition: what each tool does, what it takes and gives back, and how it runs.

payload.label: Video editing: find moments, reframe, change speed, captions, colour, layers, render and export
Apply a device's message to a recording session
payload.job: Update a multi-camera recording session when one device (a camera, a watch, a remote control) joins, leaves, reports its state or hands over the primary role
payload.description: Give session ({ id, states, primary?, devices? }: states are the states a device can report, the first being where a joining device starts; leave out primary and devices for a new session) and message ({ session, device, type }): type join (role primary or secondary, default secondary), leave, state (state: one of the session's states) or handover (from: the current primary, device: the one taking over). Returns the session after the message. A message for another session, with no device, from a device that never joined, joining twice, taking a primary that is held, handing over from a device that is not primary, naming an unknown state or type, changes nothing and returns the session as it was with ignored { reason, message }. Exactly one device is primary; the primary leaving leaves none. Nothing is kept: hand the returned session in with the next message.

payload.label: Generate an image locally
payload.job: Generate an original image from a visual brief with your chosen local image model, for an article hero, thumbnail or illustration
payload.description: Runs MFLUX on your Apple Silicon Mac through its public, MIT-licensed MCP server. Uses your computer for inference. The selected model is explicit; no paid provider or hosted inference fallback. First use downloads that model. Returns the completed PNG in your files.

brief.description: Describe the picture or requested edit. Include the scene and visual style; never copy a page title or subtitle into the image.

model.description: The local model name you chose, from the available local image models. Its weight license must permit this use.

payload.label: Edit an image locally
payload.job: Edit an image from your files using an image editing brief and your chosen local model
payload.description: Runs MFLUX on your Apple Silicon Mac through its public, MIT-licensed MCP server. Uses your computer for inference. The selected model is explicit; no paid provider or hosted inference fallback. First use downloads that model. Returns the completed PNG in your files.

brief.description: Describe the picture or requested edit. Include the scene and visual style; never copy a page title or subtitle into the image.

model.description: The local model name you chose, from the available local image models. Its weight license must permit this use.

image.description: An image identity from your files.

payload.label: Cut the person out
payload.job: Cut the person out of one frame of a recording and keep them as a picture with a transparent background
payload.description: Cut the person out of one frame of a recording and keep them as a picture with a transparent background. Each result is a new file kept in your files; the recording itself is never changed.

video.description: The recording to take the frame from: its identity in your files (1f: then 64 hex), as find_file or list_files returns it

at.description: Seconds into the recording for the frame (default: its sharpest, best-lit moment)

payload.label: A sound effect made in code and tuned by listening, on your computer
payload.job: Make a sound effect in code on my computer and keep the versions that sound most like my description
payload.description: Makes a sound effect in code with earshot's forge: renders candidates of a synthesis recipe, scores each by how much it sounds like the description and less like the confusions (and like the real recordings, when given), and keeps the most different good ones. No model makes the audio, so what it makes is free of model licences. Runs on your computer.

sound.description: The sound, described in a few words: what it is aimed at

recipe.description: The earshot forge recipe that synthesizes it (keypress, click, whoosh, impact, pluck, ...)

alts.description: Sounds it must sound less like

refs.description: Real recordings of this kind of sound to compare with (paths on this computer)

count.description: How many different versions to keep (default 4)

settings.description: Your settings for this computer, laid over the maker's: where its program, code and weights are, and any tuned numbers (the tool's settings record, as one object)

payload.label: A sound effect from Stable Audio 3, on your computer
payload.job: Make sound effects from a description with Stable Audio 3 on my computer
payload.description: Makes sound effects from a description with Stable Audio 3 Small-SFX on your computer, one per seed, each scaled under full scale instead of clipped. The model's licence is the Stability AI Community License: read it before a public use of what it makes.

sound.description: The sound, described in a few words

seconds.description: How long each one is made

count.description: How many to make, one seed each (default 4)

settings.description: Your settings for this computer, laid over the maker's: where its program, code and weights are, and any tuned numbers (the tool's settings record, as one object)

payload.label: A sound effect from MOSS-SoundEffect, on your computer
payload.job: Make sound effects from a description with MOSS-SoundEffect on my computer
payload.description: Makes sound effects from a description with MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 on your computer, one per seed. Its VAE is Tencent's HunyuanVideo-Foley VAE under the Tencent Hunyuan Community License: read both licences before a public use of what it makes.

sound.description: The sound, described in a few words

seconds.description: How long each one is made

count.description: How many to make, one seed each (default 4)

settings.description: Your settings for this computer, laid over the maker's: where its program, code and weights are, and any tuned numbers (the tool's settings record, as one object)

payload.label: A sound-effect track for a whole video, from its picture, on your computer
payload.job: Make a sound-effect track for my video from what it shows
payload.description: Makes one sound-effect track as long as the video, from its picture and a description, with HunyuanVideo-Foley XXL on your computer: windows of at most 15 seconds at the section starts, joined so every sample keeps its video time. Tencent Hunyuan Community License: its territory excludes the EU, the UK and South Korea; read it before a public use.

video.description: The video (a path on this computer); it is only read

sounds.description: The kinds of sound wanted, in a few words

section_starts.description: Seconds where the video's sections start, so no window crosses one

count.description: How many tracks to make, one seed each (default 1)

settings.description: Your settings for this computer, laid over the maker's: where its program, code and weights are, and any tuned numbers (the tool's settings record, as one object)
